content: rachel (Design): quick accessibility note on the model activity chart legend — keyboard users can't tell which legend item is focused. currently we only show a faint underline on hover. owen (Frontend): this is the inline legend with colored swatches and labels right? we render each item as a span. rachel (Design): yes. hover shows underline but keyboard focus gives no visible change. contrast on the swatch border is also low in light theme. lucy (A11y): for interactive legend items we should make them real buttons (or role=\"button\") with tabindex. add clear focus styles (outline) and ensure the swatch has a 3:1 contrast border against the chart bg for focus visibility. also supply `aria-pressed` to indicate visibility toggle state. owen (Frontend): current markup: `Responses` owen (Frontend): propose change: `` lucy (A11y): good. focus CSS: `:focus { outline: 3px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 2px; }` — test against white and off-black chart backgrounds. For the swatch border, `border: 2px solid rgba(0,0,0,0.2)` is too light; use `rgba(0,0,0,0.5)` or a theme token that passes 3:1. rachel (Design): also a copy nit: screen reader should announce state like "Responses series visible" vs "hidden". aria-pressed toggling should handle it but confirm SR phrasing. lucy (A11y): aria-pressed already yields good announcements in most SRs. add `aria-live=\"polite\"` region for aggregate messages like "3 series visible" when users toggle multiple items quickly. debounce updates to 400ms. owen (Frontend): will implement buttons, aria-pressed, focus outline, swatch border tweak, and add SR announcer with debounce. estimate 2 dev hours + QA. dev-bot: accessibility-lint: legend-interactive (warn), legend-contrast (medium) — see https://ci.redwood/a11y/2301001112 lucy (A11y): once PR is up I'll run quick VoiceOver/NVDA checks for announce phrasing and keyboard flow. rachel (Design): thanks — prefer outline color to use `--accent-500` so it matches other controls. owen (Frontend): PR -> https://git.redwood/pr/8102 (WIP). preview -> https://deploy-preview.redwood/8102 lucy (A11y): also check tooltip timing: when focused, we shouldn't rely on hover tooltips for label context. keep visible label text and use `aria-describedby` for extra info if needed. owen (Frontend): got it. closing loop after merge.
